<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Password;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;

class PasswordController extends Controller
{
    public function index(): JsonResponse
    {
        return response()->json(Password::all());
    }

    public function store(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $model = Password::create($request->validated());
        return response()->json($model, 201);
    }

    public function show(Password $password): JsonResponse
    {
        return response()->json($password);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, Password $password): JsonResponse
    {
        $password->update($request->validated());
        return response()->json($password);
    }

    public function destroy(Password $password): JsonResponse
    {
        $password->delete();
        return response()->json(null, 204);
    }
}
